INSERT INTO conversation_compaction_artifacts (
            conversation_id,
            artifact_kind,
            policy_version,
            trigger,
            source_message_start_seq,
            source_message_end_seq,
            source_group_start,
            source_group_end,
            artifact_json
        )
        VALUES ($1, 'iterative_summary', $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8)
        RETURNING id AS "id!"
